reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: OWN-06 owns the compiled GNU object through its caller slot and uses caller-owned fixed match registers, while line/text bytes are borrowed.
owner_creation.invariant: Native compiled state has one designated caller slot.

aliases_escapes.analysis: OWN-06 match endpoints borrow line storage independently of compiled-pattern lifetime and carry no Rust owner generation.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Native results must remain tied to live line storage.

callback_targets.analysis: OWN-06 calls GNU compile/search/free entry points directly and temporarily changes global syntax; direct names do not establish owner exclusion.
callback_targets.invariant: Native call identity does not establish owner exclusion.

invalidation.analysis: OWN-06 successful recompilation retires the old compiled owner; changing line storage separately invalidates returned match endpoints.
invalidation.invariant: Pattern and source-line invalidation are distinct events.

mutation_commit.analysis: OWN-06 restores prior syntax before reporting errors or publishing a replacement pattern, but copied native fields/offset casts still require ABI proof.
mutation_commit.invariant: Global syntax recovery is not complete ABI migration.

release_pair.analysis: OWN-06 pairs regfree of native internals with free of the outer object; stack REGS_FIXED arrays are never native-owned allocations.
release_pair.invariant: Regex internals and outer-object releases must pair correctly.

error_cleanup.analysis: OWN-06 frees a failed candidate and retains the previous caller pattern slot; converted temporary text is freed after the compile call returns.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failed replacement must not retire the prior valid owner.

signals_handoff.analysis: OWN-06 restores GNU syntax on both paths today. M0-FFI-001 retains its historical title and stays open pending maintained independent closure; it is not evidence of a current un-restored syntax value. Signal-side filter release still lacks owner exclusion.
signals_handoff.invariant: Regex lifetime must be controlled outside the handler.
limitations: Source-bound author review only; no canonical ABI or independent native-boundary approval is asserted, and existing GNU findings remain open.

src/signal.rs.relationship: Handlers may enter output, filter/queue mutation or cleanup while the reviewed ordinary owner has live aliases. Target: OWN-06.
